Container.Name: rsync-dashboard
Container.Overview: Read-only dashboard for your unRAID rsync backup jobs. Reads the log files your existing rsync scripts already write and shows per-job status, duration, data transferred, and files deleted. Never touches the scripts themselves and can't trigger backups.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to reach the dashboard from a browser

Config.Name: Logs Folder
Config.Description: The folder your rsync scripts already write their logs to (LOG_DIR in your scripts). Mounted read-only -- the dashboard cannot modify or delete anything here.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone so log timestamps display correctly

Config.Name: History Limit
Config.Description: How many past runs to keep per job

Config.Name: Cache Seconds
Config.Description: How long results are cached before logs are re-read

Config.Name: State Folder
Config.Description: Small folder where the dashboard remembers which alerts it already sent, so a container update doesn't re-send them.

Config.Name: Overdue After (hours)
Config.Description: A job is Overdue when its last run is older than this. 26 = daily jobs with a 2h grace period.

Config.Name: Per-Job Intervals
Config.Description: Override the interval for specific jobs: server/category=hours, separated by ; -- e.g. unRAID-4Bay/Docker=168; unRAID-4Bay/Scratch=0 (0 = never mark that job overdue)

Config.Name: Alert Events
Config.Description: Which conditions send a notification: any of overdue, interrupted, failed, warning (comma-separated). Default skips failed/warning because your scripts already notify those.

Config.Name: Dashboard URL
Config.Description: Optional link appended to every alert, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8686

Config.Name: Telegram Bot Token
Config.Description: From @BotFather. Leave blank to disable Telegram alerts.

Config.Name: Telegram Chat ID
Config.Description: Chat or group ID that receives alerts

Config.Name: Telegram Topic ID
Config.Description: Optional: message_thread_id of a forum topic inside the group

Config.Name: Discord Webhook URL
Config.Description: Channel webhook URL. Leave blank to disable Discord alerts.

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: Mail server hostname. Leave blank to disable e-mail alerts.

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: 587 = STARTTLS (default), 465 = SSL

Config.Name: SMTP User
Config.Description: Login username (also used as the From address if SMTP From is blank)

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: Login password / app password

Config.Name: SMTP From
Config.Description: Sender address (optional)

Config.Name: SMTP To
Config.Description: Recipient address(es), comma-separated
